## Summary

A task now closes when its review passed, wherever that review was persisted, so finished work stops
accumulating in `IMPLEMENTING`. The close-out gate reads the review directory the run recorded. The
same change normalizes the stored status token, so a legacy `done` no longer hides a finished task.

### How to test

- Approve a spec, implement it, run `crew review`, then `crew open pr` and confirm the task flips to `DONE`.
- Review a task in PR mode and confirm `--mark-done` accepts it.
- Run `crew ls` and confirm a legacy `done` spec counts as done.

Automated: `crew test` passes in the worktree.
